some technical update. Also played some time. found some bugs and fixed them.
fix damage zone
fix graphic settings and render resolution
fix mouse cursor in multiplayer esc menue
added more fog
fixed bug with mousecursor
player reacts now physical to attacks
reduced game size from 500mb to 340mb , download size now 84mb

notes.title: Update 8.07
notes.notes: The endless mode was changed to difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard, very hard, hell on earth, impossible). You start in easy mode. Surviving for 5 minutes and kill all so far spawned zombies to unlock next level.

notes.title: Update 14.04
notes.notes:
newest update 14.04:

-added gamestats that are shown up for 8 secounds when dead.
You see now how much you have killed and how long you survived.
(You can also take a steam screenshot (Default key F12) .
You have to configure the scrennshoot folder in your steam settings)
-Steam overlay works (Default key Shift+Tab)

notes.title: Tech Update 12.03
notes.notes:
12.03:

- ambient oclussion added to improve look.
- no more screen tearing, when moving the weapon.
- improved hit detection at point blank shoots.
- switching to very high quality level will raise render quality to max.
  switching  to any other quality level will set render quality to default value.

The improvements will loose some performance but it should still fit.
